# Relevance fixture exemptions

- `relevance.intentional_trap` — `upgrade.alpha` is intentionally represented by its declared substitute group.
- `relevance.dead_fixture` — `upgrade.dead` is an intentionally unreachable negative-control fixture.
- F7 fixture repair — `generator.beta`'s fixture-only price/rate pair restores a nonzero
  equal-decision-envelope greedy/beam gap while retaining the two exemption proofs above.
